## Contact us

![](https://castlesidcup.com/static/images/hello.png)

Looking to change or cancel your booking?  
We understand things can change at the last minute. If you give us at least 4hrs notice, we can give you a voucher for the value of your tickets.  
[Submit a voucher request here.](https://forms.gle/TSkJ649dgmrJat978)

For all other questions, the quickest way to contact us is hello@castlesidcup.com  
We don’t have a phone line, so we’re super speedy with email responses instead!

If you can’t book online due to accessibility requirements, email us and we’ll give you a call to complete your booking over the phone.

For everything else, please [check out our handy FAQs](https://castlesidcup.com/faq/).

Sign up to our [mailing list](https://mailchi.mp/d56228eceb88/castle-sidcup-newsletter) if you'd like a lovely email in your inbox once a week. We'll let you know about all of the exciting films, events and other things we've got coming up!

You can also keep an eye on our [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/castlesidcup) and [Instagram](http://www.instagram.com/castlesidcup) pages to stay up to date on what we're up to!

If your enquiry isn’t urgent and you’d like to speak to the cinema directors directly, you can do so [here](https://forms.gle/4yuL6vp9gSe2s7Sc7).

### Hires

Hire Screen 1, Screen 2, Screen 3 and the bar! Check out our [private hire packages](https://castlesidcup.com/private-hire/) and email hire@castlesidcup.com for a quote.

### Jobs

If you'd like to work with us, fill out the form [here](https://near.tl/sm/IfGOTGtRq).  
We're always on the lookout for brilliant, sparkly people to join the team :)

## Find us

![](https://castlesidcup.com/static/images/torch.png)

You can find us in the heart of Sidcup High Street. Our address is:

**The Castle Cinema Sidcup**  
**Storyteller Building, 106 High St**  
**Sidcup, London, DA14 6DS**

## Booking info

Tickets can be booked online or in person at the box office.

### Ticket prices

We want everyone to feel part of The Castle Cinema – that’s why membership is essentially free, with tickets included when you join!

On top of cheaper ticket prices you get a load of other benefits too, and you can sign up online. Check out the [Membership page](https://castlesidcup.com/membership/) to find out more.

|                        | **Member** | Standard | Concession | Kids  |
|------------------------|------------|----------|------------|-------|
| Monday (cheap day)     | **£6.00**  | £7.00    | n/a        | £6.00 |
| Tue – Fri (before 5pm) | **£6.00**  | £9.95    | £8.95      | £6.95 |
| All other times        | **£9.95**  | £11.95   | £10.95     | £8.95 |

**Pay What You Can** – Every Saturday or Sunday morning, we offer a film from our standard programme at a Pay What You Can price. We believe cost shouldn’t be a barrier to enjoying a great cinema experience, so tickets start from just £3.

The not-so-small print – Matinees start before 17:00 on weekdays, and 12:00 at the weekend. Kid's tickets are available to children aged 14 and under. Under 12’s must be accompanied by an adult. For parent and baby screenings, children must be aged under 1 year old (and they watch for free!). Live screenings and events are priced individually.

## Get involved

We want everyone to get involved with The Castle Cinema, and there are loads of ways to do so…

### Screen

- Got an idea for an event, workshop or talk?
- Are you a local filmmaker who’d like to screen your work?
- Do you organise a film festival – or want to start one?

If the answer is yes, get in touch at hire@castlesidcup.com.

### Work

- We're always on the lookout for brilliant, sparkly people to join the team.

If you'd like to work with us, fill out the form [here](https://near.tl/sm/IfGOTGtRq).

### Host

- Are you a community group looking for a place to meet?
- Are you a parent or teacher interested in learning through film?
- Do you want to run a film club (for adults or kids)?

Let us know at events@castlesidcup.com.

### Sell

- Are you a local producer of tasty drinks or snacks?
- Are you a local maker of cards, knitting, jewellery or other fabulous things?
- Are you an artist?

We want to know more at bar@castlesidcup.com.

## Private Hire

Whether you’re planning a birthday party, corporate presentation, film screening, wedding celebration or community event, Castle Sidcup offers a range of beautiful, flexible spaces to make it special.

Email hire@castlesidcup.com for a personalised quote or more information - we’d love to help you plan your event.

**Screen 1 & Screen 2 – Intimate Cinema Experiences**  
Each of our two boutique screens seats up to 44 guests, plus a wheelchair space, making them perfect for private film screenings, presentations, gaming sessions or children’s parties. With comfortable seating and state-of-the-art projection and sound, they offer a truly cinematic experience on a smaller scale.

**Screen 3 – Our Largest Auditorium**  
Seating up to 69 guests (plus a wheelchair space), Screen 3 is ideal for larger celebrations, premieres, corporate events or school bookings. It combines the magic of the big screen with the charm and comfort you’d expect from Castle Sidcup.

**The Studio – Flexible & Creative**  
Our Studio is a versatile event space that can host around 60 guests seated or up to 80 standing. Perfect for workshops, yoga classes, talks, rehearsals, networking events, live performances, kids parties or drinks receptions, it’s a flexible blank canvas that can be tailored to your needs.

**Full Venue Hire – Make It Yours**  
For something truly special, you can hire the entire venue - all three screens, the Studio and our bar/café space – accommodating up to 120 guests standing. Ideal for large-scale celebrations, brand takeovers, weddings or private parties, full venue hire gives you exclusive access to Castle Sidcup. Please note: private bar hire is available as part of full venue hire only.

All hires are charged hourly, with a minimum of 2 hours for screens and 1 hour for the Studio.
